caption: The video captures a barefoot dancer in a black spaghetti-strap top and a long pink wrap skirt with a green sash, standing before a mirrored wall in a pale studio. She moves in place through a slow, continuous sequence of controlled gestures. One arm extends sideways while the other bends near her waist. Both hands then settle low at her hips as her torso turns. She opens her arms wide to the sides, lifts them forward and upward into an extended pose, and raises her hands toward her head. As the arms lower again, one foot lifts behind her. The pink fabric and green sash sway and fold with each shift of weight. Her reflection tracks these movements as a mirrored front view, while the barre, framed pictures, and floor lines stay fixed in the steady camera frame.
